# ADR-3112: A10: Egress allow-list configuration for fetcher 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Open egress turns SSRF into intranet scanning.

## Decision

Fetcher configuration MUST declare an egress allow-list configuration for fetcher 4 (A10-4).

## Consequences

Deny-by-default egress is preferred.
